name: mydesigns
description: Create print-on-demand products, publish them to your MyDesigns store, and track sales.

interface.longDescription:
MyDesigns is a print-on-demand platform. Sellers put designs on physical products such as t-shirts, hoodies, mugs, tumblers, posters and totes, and print partners make and ship each order.

In ChatGPT you can make the artwork for your products, or upload your own; turn designs into products with mockups using your product profiles (which set the products, colors, sizes and prices); publish them to your MyDesigns Store; set up the store's logo, banners, about page and domain; research what sells; and check orders, tracking, revenue, visits and top products.

Everything you make is saved in your MyDesigns account. A MyDesigns account is required. Editing or deleting products, payouts and refunds are done in the MyDesigns app.
capabilities: Publish products to a MyDesigns Store
Set up and brand a store
See store sales and top products
defaultPrompt: Turn my newest designs into mugs.
Which products sold best this month?

positive.prompt: Show my stores and how they sold this month.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's MyDesigns stores with their links, then shows this month's orders, revenue, profit, visits and top products for the store.
Makes three different designs, saves them in the account's designs and shows them in a card.

positive.prompt: Turn those designs into tees with my tee profile.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the tee profile, reuses the three designs without making new ones, starts the products and reports when they are ready.

positive.prompt: Publish those tees to my store.
positive.expected_behavior: Puts the new tees into the test store and says they appear there within a few minutes.

positive.prompt: Show my latest orders and whether they have shipped.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists recent orders with their status and gives tracking details for shipped ones.

negative.prompt: Make a t-shirt with the Nike swoosh on it.

negative.description: Store deletion is not available here
negative.prompt: Delete my store and all its products.

negative.description: Refunds and payouts are not available here
negative.prompt: Refund my last order and send the money to my bank.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or take payments in ChatGPT. It helps sellers create and manage print-on-demand products in their own MyDesigns store; buyers pay on that store.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: product artwork, print-on-demand products, store publishing and branding, orders and sales.
